# Adaptive approach to index/ETF constituent arbitrage

A concept shared by **2** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,418. ## Description

Proposed adaptive approach to index/ETF constituent arbitrage: Estimate fair-value differences between an index-linked instrument and its constituent basket, then evaluate convergence trades only after accounting for synchronized prices, basket execution, fees, and slippage. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
